source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.stems: Young stems glabrous or nearly so
morphology_documented.leaves: Opposite, sessile or subsessile, ovate to elliptic or obovate, 3–6(–7) cm long × 2–4 cm wide; subleathery, obtuse to acute apically, often glaucous beneath; upper 1–2 or more pairs perfoliate
morphology_documented.flowers: Terminal whorls, tubular corolla 25–50 mm long by genus key; usually red outside and orange inside, shallow lobes nearly equal
morphology_documented.fruit: Red to reddish-orange berries 6–10 mm diameter
morphology_documented.habitat: Stream banks, hillside woods; also cultivated

source_scope_note: Species vs. genus or key-level characters distinguished in each entry. No missing traits inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Compare L. albiflora's 12–18 mm creamy white corollas
Corolla numerical range comes from genus key, not individual species paragraph
preservation: Additive record; original species.json, media, credits and galleries unchanged
